description: This file defines a Config class and a ConfigAttribute class for managing application configuration in a Flask-based project. It includes methods for loading configuration from files, environment variables, objects, and mappings, as well as handling nested environment variables and namespace filtering.

classes.name: ConfigAttribute
classes.description: A descriptor class that forwards attribute access to the application's config dictionary, with optional value conversion.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A dictionary subclass that provides methods to load configuration data from various sources such as files, environment variables, objects, and mappings, with support for nested environment variables and namespace filtering.

methods.name: from_envvar
methods.description: Loads configuration from a file specified by an environment variable.

methods.name: from_prefixed_env
methods.description: Loads environment variables with a specific prefix into the config, supporting nested keys and JSON parsing.

methods.name: from_pyfile
methods.description: Loads configuration from a Python file.

methods.name: from_object
methods.description: Loads configuration from a module or object, importing uppercase attributes.

methods.name: from_file
methods.description: Loads configuration data from a file using a specified loader function.

methods.name: from_mapping
methods.description: Updates the config with a mapping or keyword arguments, ignoring non-uppercase keys.

methods.name: get_namespace
methods.description: Returns a subset of configuration options matching a namespace prefix.
